blocking_findings: The proven Wave1 backend trained a 0.5B model in float32 on GitHub-hosted CPU runners; this does not prove 3B or 4B training feasibility.
The proven Wave1 LoRA workflow and training script are not present on main and therefore are not a current main-branch dispatch backend.
No verified GPU, QLoRA, bitsandbytes, or equivalent target-core training backend was found on main during this audit.
No real WAVE3A target-core adapter has been trained, hashed, stored, and read back.
A successful inference canary is not evidence that LoRA training fits memory or runtime limits.
requirements_to_pass: Provide a main-branch dispatch workflow with an explicit real-training contract.
Pin the exact target model revision used by each role.
Run a target-core training canary that performs at least one optimizer step and proves adapter tensors changed.
Persist the adapter outside GitHub artifacts as required and verify SHA-256 by readback.
Record runner hardware and peak memory evidence sufficient for the selected parallelism.
Keep COLD, TRANSFER, RED and M6 denied from training.
Only then set this evidence status to VERIFIED_EXECUTABLE_BACKEND after independent gate review.
